findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: render_gradient, list_palettes · Private data: render_gradient, list_palettes · Public sink: render_gradient, list_palettes, suggest_settings.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: render_gradient, list_palettes · Private data: render_gradient, list_palettes · Public sink: render_gradient, list_palettes, suggest_settings

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
